1.

Father! We Thy love extol And Thy counsel of salvation, Who can know all Thy goodness, All Thy grace!

2.

No forgiveness now remains hidden from Thee, For it has been rent asunder, All Thy grace is now in Christ Manifest.

3.

He the great work has accomplished, The toil is past; In the love wherein He rests, We rest.

4.

Jesus! Thou Thyself hast given, Faultless Offering Lamb. From Thy cross God’s grace and love Flow forth.

5.

Yea, God’s love-sun now shines Unveiled down. Up, my soul, to praise the Father And adore!
